reason: When I need something for the kids that I can't find in Baghdad, I message the Instagram page I already use. They know me, I know their prices, and I don't want to risk an urgent order on a new name I've never heard of.
objection: 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item is a lot for my budget, and 2 to 3 weeks is too slow when I need the thing now. My usual page is cheaper or at least I'm used to it.
would_change_my_mind: If they could get it to me in about a week and the fees were clearly lower than my usual page, I'd try one small order.
